newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Exploration placement raises $24 mln.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Exploration placement raises $24 mln.

text.p: United States Exploration Inc said Wednesday it completed the private placement of its Series C convertible preferred stock, raising $24 million in additional working capital.
Proceeds of the offering were used to extinguish outstanding term debt of about $6 million. The balance is expected to be used for acquiring additional properties and producing reserves.

Under terms of the placement memorandum dated September 17, 1996, the oil and gas exploration, development and production company placed four million preferred shares at a purchase price of $6 per share.
The preferred pays dividends of eight percent a year and may be redeemed at the company's option beginning March 17, 1997.
